regressions.finding: Manual Transfer-Encoding could conflict with JDK Content-Length framing
regressions.before: e3cd222 parser accepted the header; independent raw-wire review observed Content-Length:5 and Transfer-Encoding:chunked with an unchunked hello body. The new regression failed on its forbidden-header send path.
regressions.fix: Reject Transfer-Encoding through the existing case-insensitive managed-header check before constructing a network call.

regressions.finding: Lexer reported state after its current token rather than token-start state
regressions.before: New SDK contract probe failed restarting GET as URL at offset0.
regressions.fix: Capture expectRequestTarget at the beginning of advance and expose that token-start state.

regressions.finding: Quoted text and unfinished variables could swallow later physical lines, request separators and gutter methods
regressions.before: At52d7b2b the new semantic probe failed on a text/plain body containing don't followed by ### Next and GET; the string token consumed the remainder.
regressions.fix: Stop quoted/variable scanning before CR/LF, do not let escape handling consume a line break, and consume variable-closing braces only when present.
regressions.cases: 20 LF/CRLF cases cover plain apostrophes, unfinished single/double quotes, backslashes before line breaks, unfinished body/header variables, and retained valid escaped quotes/complete same-line variables.
